item.name: Shared Seed of Greenbarrow
item.description: An ancestral relic from the First Seed Cache. It multiplies only when entrusted to many hands, making it useless to hoarders and vital to the Astral Crown ward.

item.name: Lucky Pie Tin
item.description: A dented tin with Kite Underhill’s initials scratched on the bottom. It is not an effective shield, but do not tell Kite.

item.name: Barrow Name Rubbing
item.description: A charcoal rubbing preserving ancestor names scratched from the clover barrows.

item.name: Stolen Grain Tally
item.description: A co-op tally altered to make the grain theft look like neighborly betrayal instead of enemy sabotage.

item.name: Grave-Loam Sample
item.description: A sealed clay pot of dark loam collected with proper offerings and minimal academic shouting.

item.name: Dawn-Forge Keystone
item.description: A sun-iron keystone from the first free forge of Dawnhammer. It brightens only for willing hands, making it useless to slavers and essential to the Astral Crown ward-chain.

item.name: Altered Caravan Writ
item.description: A doctored freight writ showing that a false buyer knew Dawnhammer's convoy schedule.

item.name: Raider Coded Bill
item.description: A compact order sheet written in procurement cipher for stolen sun-iron lots.

item.name: Shift Ledger Copy
item.description: A copy of Bhon Falduhr's missing shift pattern, proving the raids used private mine schedules.

item.name: Lost Shift Tally Stone
item.description: A flat stone scratched with a miner's shift mark, carried too far into the old dark.

item.name: Bone-Rail Brake Pin
item.description: A blackened brake pin that kept the necromantic tram running in a cursed loop.

item.name: Broken Sun-Iron Slave Chain
item.description: A broken length of new chain forged from stolen sun-iron, proof of the Cabal's intended enslavement program.

item.name: Cabal Weapon Schematic
item.description: A stolen design packet for sun-iron spearheads, siege rivets, and slave-collar hinges bearing false Vandarom marks.

item.name: Black Sigil-Bone
item.description: A bone shard used to corrupt maker marks and make honest tools certify tyrant work.

item.name: Crownroot Thorn Sigil
item.description: A living thorn-and-star sigil recovered from the Nameless Oracle’s pool. It is one of the ward relics needed to trace the Astral Crown route.

item.name: Vowtree Ribbon
item.description: A ribbon from the Vowtree Grove, still warm with the memory of a promise.

item.name: Name-Shard
item.description: A sharp syllable of a stolen name. Carrying it makes your own name feel louder.

item.name: Moonlit Orrery Lens
item.description: The missing lens that allows the Lost Orrery to show the dead star’s relation to the Astral Crown ward-chain.

item.name: Memory Droplet
item.description: A suspended droplet containing an inconvenient memory from Onfadell’s past.

item.name: Hawga Daar Oath-Scale
item.description: A polished green-black scale etched with a clan spiral. The gate-speakers of Hawga Daar recognize it as proof that the bearer acted for the brood before asking favors.

item.name: Brood-Reed Shells
item.description: Warm fragments of reed-wrapped eggshell recovered from a threatened hatchery. The lizardfolk consider them evidence, not treasure.

item.name: Lost King Tablet
item.description: A mud-dark stone tablet bearing Draconic marginalia over older royal script. The phrase Hawga Daar, Lost King, is carved twice.

item.name: Crown Mosaic Rubbing
item.description: Waxed cloth pressed against a vault mosaic showing a crown divided into star-metal bands.

item.name: Drowned Band of the Astral Crown
item.description: A crescent band of star-silver recovered beneath the Sunken Vaults. It is one structural band of the Astral Crown itself, drowned with the old keep when the lost kingdom confused custody with ownership.

item.name: Waterlogged Royal Banner
item.description: A faded banner of the lost kingdom. Its gold thread forms half of an unfamiliar crown pattern.

item.name: Titan-Bone Rubbing
item.description: A charcoal rubbing from a buried giant rib-stone along the highway, marked with old spell-routing notations.

item.name: Ajuna Mirror Angle
item.description: The first tower alignment reading, recorded in bright blue ink and wrapped in starcloth.

item.name: Shakni Mirror Angle
item.description: The third tower alignment reading, written as a silent notch pattern in white glass.

item.name: Invisible Map Fragment
item.description: A translucent dungeon plan that becomes visible only when held over a shadow instead of a flame.

item.name: Mirage Shard of the Astral Crown
item.description: A crown-fragment of impossible glass that does not reflect the bearer. The Silver Concord believes it once served as the Astral Crown’s lens for hiding ward-sites from extraplanar hunters.

item.name: Tidecrown Pearl of Glendes
item.description: A moonlit pearl kept beneath the Glendes Islands by Eshdru. It is a Duskfall relic of tide-law, safe passage, and worthiness rather than a plainly labeled story fragment.

item.name: Forged Privateer Warrant
item.description: A Tidebound-style privateer bond bearing the wrong seal, used by pirate captains to pass as legal raiders.

item.name: Salt-Dry Bombardment Fuse
item.description: A treated powder fuse taken from kobold sappers along the breakwater.

item.name: Roll of Pirate Signal Flags
item.description: A damp bundle of flags used to coordinate kobold rafts and human privateer cutters.

item.name: Sealed Reef-Lamp Oil Cruse
item.description: A wax-sealed cruse of pale oil used to relight the Reefmist Shrine.

item.name: Carved Kobold Oar Token
item.description: A little carved oar proving which raft-clan took part in the assault.

item.name: Salt Cod Crate
item.description: A heavy crate of preserved cod meant for the wall crews and refugee kitchens.

item.name: Cut Rope Sample
item.description: A length of shipyard rope sliced with a privateer rigging knife, not a dockworker’s tool.

item.name: Glendes Island Tide Chart
item.description: A waterproof chart showing reef lanes, pirate drift routes, and the approach to the Buried Labyrinth.

item.name: Buried Labyrinth Wall Rubbing
item.description: A charcoal rubbing of serpent paths, tide marks, and false compass signs from the Glendes ruin.

item.name: Thunderheart Aegis
item.description: A storm-giant wardstone shaped like a shielded heart. It belongs to Thundervale first: a relic of protective thunder, rightful restraint, and weather brought back into balance.

item.name: Charged Stormlift Sigil
item.description: A repaired giant ascent key made from recovered storm-rune components, sky-iron, and Orvanth’s patient rune-work. It wakes the Stormlift at Vhal Torunn.

item.name: Cloud-Smith Coil
item.description: A stolen stormlift coil recovered from Cabal sappers. Orvanth can use it to charge the ascent sigil.

item.name: Tempest Archive Page
item.description: A copied weather record linking the dead-star omen to forced changes in the mountain storm cycle.

item.name: Nightscale Lantern
item.description: A black-glass lantern made from a shed scale of Vorgul Nethra. It reveals hidden writing, false walls, shadow-bound spirits, and the true path through the dead star’s darkness without declaring itself an Astral Crown shard.

item.name: Glowcap Safe-Lantern
item.description: A compact lantern sealed with Compact spores and deep crystal. It marks the bearer as someone who has paid the first debt of light.

item.name: Stolen Light-Crystals
item.description: Recovered underworld light-crystals. In the Depths they are food, medicine, map, and weapon all at once.

item.name: Duergar Debt-Token
item.description: A stamped iron marker proving a duergar exile owes aid, testimony, or steel.

item.name: Blackflame Shutter
item.description: A hinged plate of negative fire used by Cabal binders to trap a shadow without extinguishing it.

item.name: Ossuary Sun-Mote
item.description: A warm mote of buried daylight stolen from the ossuary’s false night. It hurts to carry, but the shadows obey it.

item.name: Cracked Sky Music Box
item.description: A surface-made music box carried below generations ago. It plays a tinny melody about morning clouds.

item.name: Grief-Spores
item.description: Pale spores gathered from a mourning cleft. The Mycelial Choir uses them to digest dangerous memories.

item.name: Nhalira’s Chain Glyph
item.description: A torn glyph from Sister Nhalira’s binding circle, proving the Cabal intended to enslave the Umbralwyrm rather than merely awaken it.

item.name: Crown-Rite Sigil
item.description: A dangerous sigil of rulership without consent. It can force a control option against the Crownless Lich, but owning it is already a moral wound.

item.name: Healing Draught
item.description: A red cordial that restores a dependable amount of health during or after danger.

item.name: Mana Phial
item.description: Blue-white liquid used by casters to recover spell power.

item.name: Antitoxin
item.description: A bitter vial that cures common venoms and marsh rot.

item.name: Travel Rations
item.description: Salted bread, nuts, dried fruit, and hard cheese for the road.

item.name: Oath-Tallow Candle
item.description: A temple candle that steadies frightened witnesses and briefly reveals magical pressure on sworn statements.

item.name: Applewallow Hand Pie
item.description: A hot apple hand pie wrapped in cloth. It tastes like someone expected you to survive.

item.name: Cider-Vinegar Flask
item.description: A sharp little flask used by farmers to clean bites, wake fainting cousins, and discourage burrow vermin.

item.name: Miner's Dawn-Candle
item.description: A squat candle used in mine memorials. Its flame leans away from unsafe air and restless dead.

item.name: Briar-Mere Lily
item.description: A silver-veined lily that clears minor charms and calms panic when brewed as tea.

item.name: Sweetroot Cake
item.description: A dense market cake that tastes different every season and restores a modest amount of health.

item.name: Pepper-Reed Fish Stew
item.description: A spicy stew served in a shell bowl. It restores strength and proves Hawga Daar cooks trust you enough not to underfeed you.

item.name: Kelpcook Stew
item.description: A thick bowl of kelp, cod, crab, and pepper that restores strength and makes rain feel less personal.

item.name: Thunder Balm
item.description: A sharp-smelling balm that steadies breathing and closes burns caused by lightning or cold wind.

item.name: Spore-Sealed Rations
item.description: Dense fungus cakes wrapped in waxy leaves. They restore strength without attracting most cave predators.

item.name: Starless Healing Tonic
item.description: A thick silver-red tonic brewed in the Refuge infirmary for wounds made by planar blades.

item.name: Starless Mana Tonic
item.description: A cold draught of distilled astral vapor that restores late-stage spell power.

item.name: Thieves Tools
item.description: Slim picks, tension keys, wax, wire, and quiet confidence.

item.name: Tracking Kit
item.description: Chalk, twine, scent cloth, field lenses, and small tags for mapping trails.

item.name: Ink Sigil Kit
item.description: Arcane inks, sand, pins, and vellum for copying runes safely.

item.name: Concordium Chalk
item.description: Silver-blue chalk used to trace unstable runes, calibrate lantern arrays, and mark safe spellcasting circles.

item.name: Old Burrow Map
item.description: A folded cloth map showing abandoned badger runs, root cellars, and three tunnels marked DO NOT TRUST.

item.name: Tunnel Lantern
item.description: A squat lantern with a hooded wick designed for low burrows and nervous hands.

item.name: Quiet Tunnel Side-Cut Map
item.description: A practical mine map showing dead ends, pitfall voids, abandoned caches, and one safer route that never stays clean.

item.name: Vault Pump Crank
item.description: A bronze-and-bone crank keyed to the old keep pumps, restored by Hawga Daar pumpwrights.

item.name: Drainage Wrench
item.description: A hooked iron wrench suited for valves, sluices, and uncooperative ancient plumbing.

item.name: Sky-Iron Grounding Spike
item.description: A heavy sky-iron spike used to redirect hostile lightning into stone instead of bone.

item.name: Sky-Iron Piton
item.description: A climbing piton that hums before lightning strikes too close.

item.name: Bone-Map of the Lower Roads
item.description: A map carved on lacquered rib plates, readable by touch in total darkness.

item.name: Wyrmglass Lens
item.description: A smoked lens cut from chasm glass. It shows shadow seams, hidden ribs, and doors that prefer darkness.

item.name: Planar Seal Stabilizer
item.description: A refugee-made tool for holding a cracked planar seal open long enough to survive the next room.

item.name: Saints Icon
item.description: A bright icon used for prayer, courage, and some temple interactions.

item.name: Bellfounder Chime
item.description: A thumb-sized bronze chime tuned by Osrik to ring softly near false oaths and old ward-stones.

item.name: Vandarom Guild Seal
item.description: A stamped brass seal proving trusted standing with the independent guilds of Vandarom.

item.name: Glassroot Charm
item.description: A little prism grown from Onfadell root-glass, useful for holding fragile memories.

item.name: Root-Mirror Shard
item.description: A shard from a root mirror that shows loyalties as colors in darkness.

item.name: Shakni Silence Charm
item.description: A sand-clock charm filled with white powder. It eats the scrape of boots, whispered passwords, and one careless cough.

item.name: Prism Focus
item.description: A seven-faced prism used to split one spell diagram into several safer approximations.

item.name: Net-Mending Charm
item.description: A small knot-charm made by Terrecester netters to keep lines from snapping under unnatural strain.

item.name: Shellbone Charm
item.description: A charm carved from white shell and old whale bone, worn by sailors to confuse hungry dead things.

item.name: Serpent-Worthy Scale
item.description: A silver-green scale granted by Eshdru’s trial. It warms near honest oaths and chills near plunder dressed as destiny.

item.name: Barometer Shell
item.description: A spiral shell that clicks before pressure changes, useful for reading storm hazards and suspicious silences.

item.name: Mycelial Memory Bead
item.description: A pearl of condensed spore-memory. Holding it produces the taste of rain, grief, and warnings spoken by the dead.

item.name: Astral Chain Ring
item.description: A ring made from a broken Cabal shackle and reversed by Refuge spellwrights.

item.name: Ashwood Staff
item.description: A caster staff cut from lightning-struck ash.

item.name: Freehold Slingstone Pouch
item.description: A belt pouch of smooth river stones painted with tiny rude comments about tyrants.

item.name: Greenwood Crook
item.description: A sheperds crook shaped from young wood, craved with a careful hand. It hums with earthen magic.

item.name: Balanced Dagger
item.description: A narrow blade weighted for quick hands and precise work.

item.name: Mace of Bells
item.description: A temple mace whose hollow head rings against undead and liars alike.

item.name: Yew Longbow
item.description: A ranger bow laminated with horn and river glue.

item.name: Plain Longsword
item.description: A practical blade used by militia fighters throughout the Marches.

item.name: Applebough Shortblade
item.description: A curved halfling field blade balanced for harvesting rope, cutting roots, and defending the supper table.

item.name: Bonehook Javelins
item.description: A bundle of hooked throwing javelins carved by Hawga Daar bonewrights.

item.name: Sun-Iron Handaxe
item.description: A practical dwarf handaxe, equally suited to splitting timber, shield rims, and bad assumptions.

item.name: Bogwalker Spear
item.description: A barbed spear balanced for thrusting from a skiff or stilt platform.

item.name: Cabalsmith Chain
item.description: A cruel hooked chain taken from Cabal overseers. Vandarom smiths can rework it, but even broken it remembers harm.

item.name: Moonthorn Rapier
item.description: A narrow Fey rapier grown around a silver thorn. It hums softly when wielded under moonlight.

item.name: Freehand Sun-Iron Axe
item.description: A Vandarom battle-axe stamped with a freehand maker mark. Its edge shines brightest when raised against coercion.

item.name: Blackwater Glaive
item.description: A lizardfolk polearm hafted in cypress and tipped with old royal steel from the drowned keep.

item.name: Sun-Glass Sabre
item.description: A curved blade of blue-veined glass-steel, light enough for caravan guards and sharp enough to sing when spellfire passes near it.

item.name: Wyrm-Edge Glassblade
item.description: A blade knapped from the Glass Wyrm’s shed crest. It catches sunlight in a line too straight to be natural.

item.name: Sea-Glass Spellhook
item.description: A hooked wand-saber made from blue sea-glass and bronze, favored by tide mages who board ships personally.

item.name: Tidebound Boarding Cutlass
item.description: A practical close-quarters blade designed for wet decks, tight alleys, and decisive arguments.

item.name: Tidebound Corsair Saber
item.description: A curved boarding saber with a wave-cut fuller and a guard shaped like a gull wing.

item.name: Stormbow Harpoon
item.description: A compact harpoon launcher fitted with storm-twine and a pulley stock.

item.name: Black Lantern Rod
item.description: A caster’s rod of bone-black iron that focuses revealing light into a blade-thin beam.

item.name: Stormglass Halberd
item.description: A polearm of sky-iron and stormglass, balanced for mortal hands by Orvanth Cloud-Smith after the Hollow Thunderforge is cleansed.

item.name: Silent Hammer of the Compact
item.description: A deep-iron hammer whose head is wrapped in memory-felt, made for breaking chains without ringing the cavern.

item.name: Nightscale Fangblade
item.description: A curved blade edged with black wyrmglass. It drinks loose shadow and gives the wielder a fraction of the dragon’s predatory patience.

item.name: Crown-Sundered Blade
item.description: A black-star blade recovered from the Unbreathing Armory, made to cut oathless bindings and planar chainwork.

item.name: Padded Jack
item.description: Layered cloth and leather meant to stop glancing cuts.

item.name: Apprentice Robe
item.description: A robe sewn with small ward knots and many ink stains.

item.name: Pilgrim Mail
item.description: Quiet ring mail under a travel cloak, blessed against fear.

item.name: Trail Leathers
item.description: Supple armor treated for rain, briars, and long marches.

item.name: Shadow Coat
item.description: A dark coat with hidden pockets and soft inner stitching.

item.name: District Patrol Cloak
item.description: A reinforced blue-gray cloak issued to trusted aides of the Marchwardens after proving useful in Hearthwatch.

item.name: Freehold Quilted Waistcoat
item.description: A sturdy waistcoat stitched with family colors, pie-crust knots, and hidden slingstone pockets.

item.name: Quarry-Bond Harness
item.description: Dwarf-made harness armor with shoulder braces for falling stone, wagon hooks, and heavy blows.

item.name: Quarry Plate
item.description: Overlapping plate built for falling stone and close-quarters tunnel fights.

item.name: Sealwarden Panoply
item.description: Plate and mantle built from stabilized citadel masonry, refugee prayer strips, and planar seal-rings.

item.name: Mantle of Green Oaths
item.description: A thorn-silk mantle that stiffens like bark when its wearer keeps a spoken promise.

item.name: Reedscale Harness
item.description: Layered marsh hide, lacquered reed plates, and old bronze buckles fitted for silent movement through water.

item.name: Mirewalker Cloak
item.description: A waxed cloak dyed with reed ash. It sheds rain, mud, and some kinds of attention.

item.name: Mirage-Silk Sash
item.description: A layered desert sash woven with heat-shimmer thread by Ajuna researchers. It helps the wearer blur against bright horizons.

item.name: Dhanor Lensbuckler
item.description: A compact buckler fitted with rotating brass lenses that bend heat and arrows slightly away from the bearer.

item.name: Cloak of the Third Horizon
item.description: A blue veil cloak stitched with three horizon-lines, awarded to travelers who survive both politics and invisible architecture.

item.name: Saltwarden Stormcoat
item.description: A reinforced oilskin coat layered with thin scale plates and tide-glass buttons.

item.name: Heavy Saltwarden Stormcoat
item.description: A heavier League stormcoat layered with chain mesh, tarred cloth, and salt-ward stitching.

item.name: Thunderstep Mantle
item.description: A blue-gray mantle woven with copper thread and rain knots. It sheds static, softens falls, and helps the wearer move between thunderbeats.

item.name: Cloud Cache Greaves
item.description: Light greaves with stormglass buckles, made for moving across wet stone without surrendering to gravity.

item.name: Shadowglass Wardplate
item.description: Segmented black glass and deep iron armor that turns necrotic force aside with a sound like distant stone cracking.

item.name: Blackscale Mantle
item.description: A mantle of overlapping shadow-drake scales that helps the wearer move where torchlight fails.

item.name: Braided Orchard Cord
item.description: A waxed cord braided from apple bark, sheep wool, and ward thread; useful for rural traps and Freehold repairs.

item.name: Greenbarrow Seed Pouch
item.description: A small pouch of hardy bean, barley, and apple seeds blessed for regrowth after blight.

item.name: Honeybell Wax
item.description: Clean beeswax from the Honeybell hives, prized for ward candles and waterproofing sling cords.

item.name: Scarecrow Button Eye
item.description: A black coat button used as the eye of an animated scarecrow. It still watches barns too closely.

item.name: Dawnhammer Rivet Stock
item.description: Precision rivets from Vandarom, useful for repairs, traps, braces, and several kinds of persuasive engineering.

item.name: Verified Sun-Iron Ingot
item.description: A warm ingot of lawful Bhon Falduhr sun-iron, cleanly assayed and stamped for free trade.

item.name: Sun-Iron Dust
item.description: Glittering filings used by smiths, ritualists, and unfortunately several kinds of necromancer.

item.name: Cache Rivets
item.description: Rugged rivets packed in oilcloth by side-cutters who assumed the mountain would try to kill someone later.

item.name: Planar Seal Shard
item.description: A broken shard of Citadel sealwork, still resonant enough to repair late-game equipment or power dangerous warding rituals.

item.name: Briar-Silver Filament
item.description: A flexible thread of living silver harvested from old Court wards and used in Fey crafting.

item.name: Moonmote Ichor
item.description: Pale luminous dust left by moon-motes. Alchemists use it to reveal invisible path marks.

item.name: Singing Leaf
item.description: A leaf that repeats one remembered melody until planted or burned.

item.name: Orrery Cog
item.description: A bronze-and-silver cog from the Lost Orrery, etched with tiny constellations.

item.name: Starwell Dust
item.description: Fine glittering dust gathered from the impossible sky inside the Starwell.

item.name: Veilpool Water
item.description: Water that reflects the drinker as they were before their first broken promise.

item.name: Echo Reed
item.description: A reed that repeats old testimony when warmed by breath.

item.name: Three Springs Silt
item.description: Silt from the meeting of Truth, Grief, and Debt. It clings to lies.

item.name: Silent Moss
item.description: Soft moss that absorbs spoken words for several heartbeats.

item.name: Nameless Oracle Tear
item.description: A black-silver tear left after the Oracle’s curse begins to fail.

item.name: Mire Serpent Fang
item.description: A curved venom tooth taken from a serpent that hunts the blackwater causeways.

item.name: Blackwater Lotus
item.description: A medicinal lotus that blooms only where old stone, warm mud, and ghost-light meet.

item.name: Crowned Silt Relic-Shard
item.description: A shard of worked stone and astral silver sifted from the Sunken Vaults.

item.name: Star-Sand Vial
item.description: Black grains of sand that glint like a sky no desert should remember.

item.name: Mirage Glass Shard
item.description: A curved shard that shows a different horizon on each side.

item.name: League Pitch-Seal
item.description: A waterproof alchemical sealant used on hulls, armor seams, and warded sea-chests.

item.name: Pitch-Seal Barrel
item.description: A small barrel of pitch-seal needed for emergency hull repairs.

item.name: Ancient Trap Spring
item.description: A tempered bronze spring pulled from one of the Buried Labyrinth’s still-working traps.

item.name: Tidecrown Pearl Shard
item.description: A harmless shed flake of pearl-light from the Tidecrown chamber, valuable to wardwrights and sea-priests.

item.name: Charged Fulmen Shard
item.description: A bright shard of hardened lightning chipped from stormglass conductors in Thundervale Peaks.

item.name: Charged Fulmen Shard
item.description: A bright shard of hardened lightning chipped from stormglass conductors in Thundervale Peaks.

item.name: Skyhook Cable
item.description: A braided length of yak hair, copper wire, and mountain linen strong enough for storm-season rope bridges.

item.name: Giant Eagle Feather
item.description: A huge feather useful for fletching, wind rites, and getting a griffon keeper’s attention.

item.name: Corpse-Lightning Rod
item.description: A blackened conductor rod used by Cabal stormbinders to drag lightning through remains.

item.name: Wyrmglass Shard
item.description: A translucent black shard formed where dragon-shadow, pressure, and time fused into mineral memory.

item.name: Shadowglass Shard
item.description: A mirror-dark crystal splinter useful in wards against necromancy and false vision.

item.name: Deep Light Crystal
item.description: A natural crystal that glows after being fed clean water and silence.

item.name: Nightscale Ink
item.description: Ink made from soot, spore oil, and a powdered scale shaving. It writes clearly only in magical darkness.

item.name: Phylactery Ash
item.description: Gray dust from a shattered Crownless anchor, dangerous to breathe and priceless to the right ward-smith.

item.name: Barrow Freehold Scrip
item.description: A stamped wooden token used for work exchange, emergency meals, and proving that someone in Applewallow vouches for you.

item.name: Miller’s Toll Token
item.description: A small wooden token good for one honest sack of milling or one very convincing lie about flour.

item.name: Marsh-Breath Charm
item.description: A small shell charm filled with bubbled air and whispered swamp-prayers.

item.name: Silt Pearl
item.description: A grey pearl formed around a flake of castle mortar, prized by marsh traders.

item.name: Saltpearl Cache
item.description: A small waxed packet of saltpearls accepted by Tidebound jewelers and less polite smugglers.

item.name: Stormglass Lantern
item.description: A lantern that burns rain-blue and reveals fresh lightning scars even through darkness.

item.name: Refuge Supply Cache
item.description: A bundle of final provisions gathered by escaped prisoners who understand that victory also requires bandages, food, chalk, and lamp oil.

item.name: Marchwarden Favor Mark
item.description: A stamped favor mark from Hearthwatch Crossing proving the bearer has been recognized by the Marchwardens during the first dead-star emergency.

item.name: Hearthwatch Civic Writ
item.description: A signed writ from the keep authorizing the bearer to question witnesses across all six districts.

item.name: Warehouse Manifest Fragment
item.description: A recovered strip of overwritten shipping ledger that links hidden crates to Crownless Cabal agents.

item.name: Baronial Tithe Marker
item.description: A cold brass token from the old lord’s tax barns, proof that Fallowmaw’s magic predates the current crisis.

item.name: Dry Blasting Powder
item.description: Old but stable blasting powder, kept dry in waxed kegs and dangerous in foolish hands.

item.name: Veskar's Black Sigil
item.description: The necromancer's personal command mark, cracked after his defeat in the Blackvein vault.

item.name: Dawn-Forge Keystone Shard
item.description: A lesser shard from the Dawn-Forge Keystone, warm with the memory of the first free hammer oath.

item.name: The Astral Crown Reassembled
item.description: The final crown-shape resolved after the Crownless Lich is defeated or overcome. It is not a ruler by itself; it is a decision waiting for the living to make it.

item.name: Court Ledger Leaf
item.description: A living archive leaf recording old Thorn Court debts in green ink.

item.name: Thorn Court Writ
item.description: An official writ granting the bearer guest-right, limited passage, and exactly worded obligations in Onfadell.

item.name: Orrery Star Chart
item.description: A shifting star chart showing Onfadell, the Grotto, Dawnhammer Hills, and a line toward the final citadel.

item.name: Truthspring Vial
item.description: A vial of painfully clear water from the Spring of Truth.

item.name: Griefspring Petal
item.description: A silver mourning petal from the Spring of Grief.

item.name: Debt-Spring Coin
item.description: An amber coin representing a favor the Thorn Court never repaid.

item.name: Last Name Fragment
item.description: A fragment of the Oracle’s erased name, dangerous because it is almost merciful.

item.name: Captain’s Oath Ring
item.description: A tarnished signet from the lost kingdom’s knight-captain, cold with a vow that never learned how to end.

item.name: Dhanor Mirror Angle
item.description: The second tower alignment reading, stamped into a brass lens-tag by the Dhanor artificers.

item.name: Sandglass Cipher Note
item.description: A folded research note that circles the word SANDGLASS three times and warns that passwords are less secure than manners.

item.name: Tidebound Checkpoint Sigil
item.description: A blue iron sigil proving you helped the League secure the coast-road checkpoint.

item.name: Sabotaged Signal Flags
item.description: A bundle of signal flags cut and resewn to give false harbor warnings.

item.name: Gale-Rune Splinter
item.description: A splinter from an old giant weather-rune, still murmuring with high wind.

item.name: Rain-Rune Cog
item.description: A rotating cog from a rain-rune mechanism beneath Thunderfall Bridge.

item.name: Climber Cache Token
item.description: A stamped copper marker proving the bearer is owed emergency supplies from a High Eyrie cache.

item.name: Rune Index Shard
item.description: A chipped index stone showing the relationship between the stormlift, the thunderforge, and the Thunderheart Aegis.

item.name: Sky-Prophecy Rubbing
item.description: A careful rubbing of a storm giant prophecy that refers to small hands mending a great weather engine.

item.name: Binder Rod Fragment
item.description: A broken piece of Vael Tormak’s conducting rod, proof of Cabal manipulation inside the Hollow Thunderforge.

item.name: Broken Chain Banner
item.description: A rough banner cut from Cabal prison-cloth and marked by every escaped people in the Refuge.

item.name: Old Baron Key
item.description: A heavy iron key stamped with the crest of the pre-Freehold tithe lord.

item.name: Side-Cutter Cache Key
item.description: A stubby brass key stamped with a wheelwright mark and old mine survey numbers.

item.name: Glassroot Key
item.description: A translucent key grown by the Verdant Archive to open scholarly seals and polite secrets.

item.name: Briar-Silver Key
item.description: A key formed from Briar-Silver Filament and old gearteeth, used by Orrery keepers.

item.name: Sluice Gate Key
item.description: A heavy key of greened bronze recovered from a drained armory locker.

item.name: Triune Mirage Index
item.description: A combined Ajuna, Dhanor, and Shakni alignment key. Its three lenses agree only when aimed at something invisible.

item.name: Stamped Terrecester Ferry Ticket
item.description: A blue-stamped Tidebound ticket purchased only at Terrecester Wharf. It authorizes the fast ferry between Terrecester and Hearthwatch Landing.

item.name: Ossuary Key-Rib
item.description: A polished rib-bone carved with Cabal hinge-glyphs and older dragon marks.

item.name: Spellbook of Prismatic Refraction
item.description: A hidden Dhanor codex that teaches how to fold light over a spell surface until hostile force mistakes the caster for somewhere else.

item.name: Spellbook of Nameward Veil
item.description: An old elven tome with instructions to protect those gifted from fey magics.

item.name: Mirage Step Field Scroll
item.description: A travel-worn Ajuna scroll containing a field-safe version of the Mirage Step formula.

item.name: Tidecall Prayer Scroll
item.description: A sea-priest scroll teaching the coastal healing rite Tidecall to a caster who can master its rhythm.

item.name: Cloudstep Scroll
item.description: A scroll teaching the first form of Cloudstep Ascent to casters patient enough to read between gusts.
